$comment: Security headers production MUST serve — the source of truth for the Headers workflow (.github/workflows/headers.yml). Each entry lists mandatory (case-insensitive) substrings in the header's value. `url` does NOT pick the request target (that is the PROD_URL constant in .github/scripts/lib/target.mjs — the scripts attach secrets to the target, so the allowlist must not come out of the same data file that chooses it): it acts as the `SET-ME` switch (nothing to check) and is compared against that constant (diverging fails the job). `url` pointed at production (2026-07-31): Cloudflare Access, which blocked unauthenticated requests and masked the daily cron's real result with the Access login page, was disabled/adjusted (confirmed by the repo owner — see docs/cloudflare-deploy.md sections 3 and 7).
